# Third-party files

- `VirtualDesktopAccessor.dll` — [Ciantic/VirtualDesktopAccessor](https://github.com/Ciantic/VirtualDesktopAccessor),
  release `2024-12-16-windows11`, MIT licence. SHA-256
  `8740c572a1c000e3b87ffeb1e4c397eae9af3bd4a2abdc3bcffacab4493f8ff5`. It wraps the undocumented
  virtual-desktop interfaces of Windows 11; Lanes embeds it and loads it at start.
